data.description:
As DXXXV says: "The realization of this edit was born from a thought fueled over the years, since the first time I saw the movie: The Mist. It is precisely in the final part that the message is clear, the moral of the story is that as long as there is life, there is hope. I did nothing but try to express through the music using the soundtrack with the fabulous voice of the artist Lisa Gerrard, the hope of returning soon to feel free as before."
